notes.title: June Dev Update – The Rewinder 2
notes.content: [p]The beginning of June was tough. A familiar environment changed unexpectedly, so I took a short break to reset—spent some time with family, went on a trip, watched a few films, and revisited some screenwriting books to clear my mind.[/p][p]Mid-month marked the official start of the Rewinder 2 remake.[/p][p]Most of this month was spent reworking the narrative and refining character development. On one hand, the story needs to integrate the newly added rewind dream levels. On the other, we're addressing some long-standing narrative structure issues:[/p][p]The Rewinder 2 has a large cast of NPCs, but many lacked depth, making it hard for players to feel invested in them or their stories.[/p][p]Key world-building elements were introduced too late in the plot, leading to a disjointed experience that felt like a deus ex machina.[/p][p]Some of these problems now have clear solutions; others still need time and iteration.[/p][p]The rest of June was spent drafting a new opening sequence and laying the groundwork for several ewind dream levels levels.[/p][p]This remake has turned out to be far more demanding than I initially expected. A book on screenwriting once said: After the darkest night of the soul comes the final battle. For me, finishing this remake is that battle. Whether the ending is happy or bittersweet, this story isn't over yet.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who's shown us care and support. If you have thoughts on the story or the rewind dream levels, feel free to leave me a message—I'd love to hear your ideas.[/p]

notes.title: An Update on Major Changes Coming to The Rewinder 2
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I’m Xinyu, the producer of [i]The Rewinder[/i].[/p][p]After carefully reviewing the project, I’ve decided to implement major adjustments to [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] in the following areas:[/p][list][*][p][b]Redesigning the "Rewind" levels[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamping village stories[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusting the narrative[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworking map designs[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improving combat mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhancing puzzle-solving and deduction elements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]English Translation[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]I hope to bring these changes to refine the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Given that the studio has disbanded and our funds are exhausted, this overhaul will require more time. However, I promise to complete all updates within [b]six months[/b]. To keep players informed, we’ll release [b]regular progress reports[/b] detailing the current status and completed tasks. I encourage everyone to follow [b]our discord or social media[/b]—not only to stay updated but also to hold us accountable.[/p][p]Since we want to focus our efforts on polishing the game to its ideal state, [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] won’t receive major updates in the short term. However, we’ll continue fixing [b]bugs and technical issues[/b]. I hope that after this large-scale update, [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] will finally meet everyone’s expectations.[/p][p]Lastly, I want to address the overwhelming response to my previous letter. I received many messages of [b]support, encouragement, and constructive criticism[/b]. Many players even offered suggestions or expressed a desire to help the studio in various ways—thank you all so much for your kindness.[/p][p]That said, simply purchasing the game is already the greatest support you can give. If you’re unsatisfied with [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] in its current state, you might consider supporting the series by purchasing:[/p][list][*][p][b][i]The Rewinder 1[/i][/b] and its [b]DLC[/b][/p][/*][*][p][i]The Rewinder 2[/i]’s [b]original soundtrack (OST)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Your understanding means the world to me, and I hope to repay your trust with [b]action, not just words[/b].[/p]

notes.title: The Rewinder 2 – Pre-Launch Q&A
notes.content:
[b]When will The Rewinder 2 be released?[/b]
The Rewinder 2 will launch on May 26, 2025 at 3:00 PM (Beijing Time GMT+8).

[b]What is the game’s price?[/b]
The game is priced $15.99 USD, with a 10% launch discount during the first two weeks.
Additionally, players who own the original The Rewinder will receive an extra 10% discount on top of the launch offer.

[b]How long is the game?[/b]
You can expect over 10 hours of gameplay.

[b]What kind of content does the game include?[/b]
The game features a large interconnected world map, with distinct regions like deserts, snowy peaks, coastal fishing villages, and classical Chinese gardens—each with their own atmosphere and folklore.
Compared to the first game, The Rewinder 2 greatly expands the series’ mythological universe, featuring:
- Over 100 unique characters
- More than 40 types of monsters

[b]What platform will the game release on?[/b]
The game will be available on Steam.

[b]Are there multiple endings?[/b]
Yes, the game features multiple endings.

[b]Will the game support macOS?[/b]
Yes, The Rewinder 2 will be Mac-compatible.

[b]What control options are available?[/b]
The game supports both keyboard & mouse and controller play.

[b]Is the game multilingual?[/b]
Yes, The Rewinder 2 will support multiple languages, including English and Simplified Chinese.

[b]Do I need to play the first game to enjoy The Rewinder 2?[/b]
Not at all!
While The Rewinder 2 continues the story after the original game, it tells a standalone narrative. You can jump right in and enjoy a complete story without prior knowledge. That said, if you’ve played the first game, you’ll notice some familiar characters making a return—which adds to the experience, but isn’t required.

[b]What are the major changes compared to the original Rewinder?[/b]
- The camera perspective has shifted from side-scrolling to top-down.
- New types of environmental puzzles that tie more closely to the world’s mythology and story.
- A new name-guessing system is introduced before the original rewinding mechanism.
- Introduction of a map system, more exploration, combat, and a new amulet system for customizing abilities.

[b]Why did the gameplay change so much compared to the first title?[/b]
We’ve always wanted to expand the world of The Rewinder, and this time we aimed to create a richer, more varied gameplay experience while keeping the story at the heart of the series.
We know the narrative is the most important part of the Rewinder series, and we’ve worked hard to refine the story while exploring new gameplay possibilities.

[b]I’m not good at action games—can I still enjoy The Rewinder 2?[/b]
Absolutely!
We’ve designed the game with both new players and fans of the original in mind.
We know many players of the first game weren’t action gamers, so we’ve included features to make The Rewinder 2 more accessible. You’ll be able to improve your combat abilities through items and skills, and we’ve added two difficulty modes that can be switched at any time:
- Recommended Mode: The default experience with full mechanics.
- Story Mode: A more relaxed experience where your character can’t die and combat stats are adjusted to let you focus on the narrative.
Choose the mode that fits your playstyle and enjoy the journey however you prefer!


We’re doing our best to expand the gameplay and introduce new possibilities—without compromising the narrative heart of the series. We also know that every new direction comes with risk. We’re deeply grateful for the continued support of players, fans, creators, and media around the world. Thank you for walking this path with us.
